DailyFoodLog.title: DailyFoodLog
DailyFoodLog.description: A user's daily calorie and macronutrient food entries for a single calendar date.

items.description: Bounded list (max 100) of food items logged for the day, each with id, meal, foodItem, quantity, measurement, calories, protein, carbs, fat, sugar, and createdAt.

/users/{userId}/logs/{date}.description: Per-user daily food logs keyed by YYYY-MM-DD date string.
